activities.name: Angels Support Operation
activities.description: Next stop: the live venue to make all Delulus' hearts skip a beat! Participate in the version event to get the Angels of Delusion's limited outfits!

activities.name: All-New Program
activities.description: During the event, log in for a total of 7 days to obtain Encrypted Master Tape ×10!

activities.name: Spooky Funhouse Tales
activities.description: When the Trickmobile enters the Funhouse, our spooky adventure begins... "We create the spookies? Things will surely get interesting~" Complete all Mission Mode stages to get a limited-time Angels of Delusion outfit from the Angels Support Operation rewards event!

activities.name: Cyber Miracle Healer, on Duty!
activities.description: Are there things even the maintenance shop owner can't handle? The Bangboo savior is here! We'll surely heal them too!

activities.name: Advanced Bounty: Area Patrol
activities.description: During the event, Area Patrol rewards will be doubled. "Battle is almost upon us! Rest assured, the Defense Force will show you who we truly are."

activities.name: "En-Nah" Into Your Lap
activities.description: Log in for a total of 7 days to earn Boopon ×10!

activities.name: Trails of the Hobbling Crow
activities.description: Nightfall, poison, and an unsuspecting victim. All the pieces are in place! It's time for the detectives to make their move... Wait, what? The victim is our great detective?

activities.name: Repair! Drifting Art
activities.description: A little art collection drifting away, a big shock dashing a Bangboo's hopes today... Only a super-skilled repair person can help restore the art collection.

activities.name: Data Bounty: Combat Simulation
activities.description: During the event, Combat Simulation rewards will be doubled. "There are many things that require your assistance, but you'll be well compensated~"
